You get a clean 5.8-inch Super Retina OLED display, a dual 12 MP camera with 2× optical zoom and Portrait Lighting, and a battery at 85% health or better. It runs up to iOS 16 — a smart first iPhone or a dependable second phone.

description.en: A compact 4.7-inch iPhone with Touch ID and a 12 MP camera that records 4K video — renewed, tested and ready for calls, WhatsApp and photos. It supports up to iOS 15, which makes it a sensible first phone for a teenager or a dependable backup.

The 4,100 mAh battery supports wireless charging and Wireless PowerShare for topping up your earbuds. Every unit passes a full functional test and ships with a 6-month Nile warranty.

description.en: OPPO's dependable everyday phone: a 6.56-inch 90 Hz display, a 5,000 mAh battery that easily lasts a full day, and an Ultra Volume mode that boosts the speaker up to 300%. The Helio G85 chip with 4 GB of RAM (plus 4 GB of extended RAM) keeps social apps and YouTube running smoothly, and IP54 protection shrugs off splashes and dust.

description.en: One of Egypt's best-selling budget phones, now at a sharper price. The realme C35 pairs a 6.6-inch Full HD+ display with a 50 MP AI triple camera and a 5,000 mAh battery with 18 W fast charging, all in a slim 8.1 mm body with a glowing green finish.
description.ar: من أكثر الموبايلات الاقتصادية مبيعًا في مصر، وبسعر أفضل الآن. يجمع ريلمي C35 بين شاشة Full HD+ مقاس 6.6 بوصة وكاميرا ثلاثية بالذكاء الاصطناعي بدقة 50 ميجابكسل وبطارية 5000 مللي أمبير بشحن سريع 18 واط، في جسم نحيف بسمك 8.1 مم ولون أخضر متوهج.
